verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official quickstart for installing and initializing the gcloud CLI, with the exact install command shown (curl https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash). The CLI manages the developer workflow, so that covers the first step of onboarding. Nothing in the pack shows a quickstart that goes from zero to a running deployed service, or any first-deploy time. missing for 10: an official deploy quickstart ending in a running service, step-by-step deploy commands, evidence of first deploy under an hour, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
